area_of_interest.intended_rule: Blorenge SSSI feature NRW_SSSI.13108 buffered by 2000 metres in EPSG:27700.

deferred_component.name: Blorenge Common
deferred_component.reason: Blorenge Common is urban common. The NRW Open Access - Registered Common Land dataset explicitly omits urban commons and contains no feature that can stand in for CL18. HM Land Registry Local Land Charges geometry has no CL18 or Blorenge identifier. The launch therefore uses the SSSI boundary without representing it as the common boundary.
deferred_component.required_action: After launch, obtain the maintained CL18 register map or GIS boundary and written public display/derivative-reuse terms from the registration authority before adding a separately labelled common-land layer. Do not substitute nearby NRW_COMMON_LAND_2014 or HMLR Local Land Charges features.

temporary_discovery_envelopes.use_limit: Discovery and over-acquisition only. The publishable AOI must be derived from the validated SSSI geometry buffered by exactly 2000 metres, not from either bounding box.

known_gaps: EFFIS dates are provider product dates, not verified ignition, control or extinction times.
